You have been provided with the babysit-pr SKILL.md as your system prompt.

Execute the SKILL.md's auto-loop on PR #{pr} with mode: {mode}.

The workflow should:
  1. Label the PR for Claude review (if not already labeled).
  2. Poll until the review posts.
  3. Hand off to stabilize-pr to triage comments and fix CI.
  4. Re-label for a follow-up review pass if new comments warrant it.
  5. Loop up to 3 no-progress cycles. In 'aggressive' mode, reschedule
     itself 2 hours later if still unresolved.
  6. Exit when: PR is merge-ready, all retry budgets exhausted, or human
     escalation is needed (write .dlc/<slug>/escalation-context.md).

Required artifacts:
  - .dlc/<slug>/_babysit.log
  - PR comments posted directly via gh CLI

When done, print exactly: BABYSIT_PR_DONE
Then surface the final status: merge-ready / escalated / retry-budget-exhausted.
